  by_cases hV : ValidCommand s r

theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := by
  intro s r hok
  by_cases hV : ValidCommand s r
  · have hstep : step s r = (.ok, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hV]
    have hs2 : (step s r).2 = ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) := by
      rw [hstep]
    have hNot : ¬ ValidCommand (step s r).2 r := by
      rw [hs2]
      intro hC
      obtain ⟨ha_mem, ht_mem, ha_admin, hgrant, hrevoke⟩ := hV
      obtain ⟨ha_mem', ht_mem', ha_admin', hgrant', hrevoke'⟩ := hC
      cases hop : r.op with
      | grant =>
        have h1 := (hgrant hop).2
        have h2 := (hgrant' hop).2
        -- h2 : (expectedHas ...) target role = false, but it is true
        have hexp : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = true := by
          unfold expectedHas
          simp [hop]
        -- h2 is stated with the anonymous state; need to unfold
        simp only [] at h2
        -- h2 should be ((... : State).has r.target r.role = false)
        rw [hexp] at h2
        contradiction
      | revoke =>
        have hop' : r.op = Op.revoke := by rw [hop]
        have h1 := (hrevoke hop').1
        have h2 := (hrevoke' hop').1
        have hexp : expectedHas s r r.target r.role = false := by
          unfold expectedHas
          simp [hop]
        rw [hexp] at h2
        contradiction
    have hstep2 : step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hNot]
    exact hstep2
  · have hstep : step s r = (.rejected, s) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hV]
    have h1 : (step s r).1 = .rejected := by rw [hstep]
    rw [h1] at hok
    contradiction

theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := by
  intro s r hex
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0mem, hu0admin⟩ := hex
  by_cases hV : ValidCommand s r
  · obtain ⟨ha_mem, ht_mem, ha_admin, hgrant, hrevoke⟩ := hV
    have hstep : step s r = (.ok, ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State)) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hV]
    have h2eq : (step s r).2 = ({ users := s.users, has := expectedHas s r } : State) := by
      rw [hstep]
    -- case split on op
    cases hop : r.op with
    | grant =>
      -- after grant, target has admin? No, only if role=admin. Need general.
      -- If role = admin then target is admin; else u0 stays admin.
      by_cases hrole : r.role = Role.admin
      · refine ⟨r.target, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h2eq]; exact ht_mem
        · rw [h2eq]
          show expectedHas s r r.target r.role = true
          unfold expectedHas
          have hcond : (r.target = r.target ∧ r.role = r.role) := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          simp [hcond, hop]
      · refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h2eq]; exact hu0mem
        · rw [h2eq]
          show expectedHas s r u0 Role.admin = true
          unfold expectedHas
          have hcond : ¬ (u0 = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role) := by
            intro ⟨_, hq⟩
            apply hrole
            exact hq.symm
          simp [hcond, hu0admin]
    | revoke =>
      have hop' : r.op = Op.revoke := by rw [hop]
      have hrev := hrevoke hop'
      obtain ⟨ht_has, hother⟩ := hrev
      -- hother only needed if role=admin
      by_cases hrole : r.role = Role.admin
      · -- need other admin
        have hOA : OtherAdmin s r.target := hother hrole
        obtain ⟨v, hv_mem, hv_ne, hv_admin⟩ := hOA
        refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h2eq]; exact hv_mem
        · rw [h2eq]
          show expectedHas s r v Role.admin = true
          unfold expectedHas
          have hcond : ¬ (v = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role) := by
            intro ⟨hv_eq, _⟩
            apply hv_ne
            exact hv_eq
          simp [hcond, hv_admin]
      · refine ⟨u0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [h2eq]; exact hu0mem
        · rw [h2eq]
          show expectedHas s r u0 Role.admin = true
          unfold expectedHas
          have hcond : ¬ (u0 = r.target ∧ Role.admin = r.role) := by
            intro ⟨_, hq⟩
            apply hrole
            exact hq.symm
          simp [hcond, hu0admin]
  · have hstep : step s r = (.rejected, s) := by
      unfold step
      simp [hV]
    have h2eq : (step s r).2 = s := by rw [hstep]
    exact ⟨u0, by rw [h2eq]; exact hu0mem, by rw [h2eq]; exact hu0admin⟩
